# Introduction

This Quarto document demonstrates how to print integers from 1 to 10 using both R and Python.

## Part 1: R Programming

The following R code uses a for loop to print integers from 1 to 10.

```{r}
for (i in 1:10) {
  print(i)
}
```

## Part 2: Python Programming

The following Python code uses a for loop to print integers from 1 to 10.

```{python}
for i in range(1, 11):
    print(i)
```

## Conclusion

Both R and Python successfully print all integers from 1 to 10 using for loops.
